name: Solarus
description: Solarus is a free, open-source engine for 2D action-RPGs in the style of The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past. It was created by Christopho and his team, initially to remake the French fan game Zelda: Mystery of Solarus. Games are written as Lua scripts and data, and run as "quests".
curiosities: Mystery of Solarus DX, its first full game, is a remake of a 2002 RPG Maker fan game.
Ocean's Heart, made with Solarus by Max Mraz, was the first Solarus game sold on Steam.
On 1 April 2011 the team released Mystery of Solarus XD, a parody spin-off.
It comes with a Quest Editor for building maps, sprites and dialogs.
